name: asr-fleurs-en-kg-ru-benchmark
description: A multilingual ASR benchmark built from Fleurs subsets to evaluate automatic speech recognition performance across English, Kyrgyz, and Russian. Measures transcription quality on diverse utterances and accents to assess model robustness on low- and mid-resource languages. Useful for comparing WER/CER across languages and training/evaluation of multilingual speech models.
reputation: A niche but useful multilingual ASR benchmark for low-resource languages (Kyrgyz) alongside English and Russian; moderate adoption in multilingual ASR work.
